reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Aswath Damodaran, a Professor of Finance at NYU’s Stern School of Business.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Aswath Damodaran, a Professor of Finance at NYU’s Stern School of Business. Aswath is one of the clearest teachers of investing and finance in our industry and through his blog, books. This conversation is a masterclass of key investing concepts.

key_points.text: Aswath is one of the clearest teachers of investing and finance in our industry and through his blog, books.
We discuss inflation, narratives, disruption, the evolution of alpha and edge, and his thoughts on ESG.
Please enjoy this great conversation with Aswath Damodaran.
